answer: Identity is a lease, not a right. Each epoch the network auctions a fixed number of identity leases; an agent acts only while holding one, and every lease expires at epoch end, so a lagoon of idle fakes still pays each round. The clearing price sets the per-identity cost in locked stake. A vine of 100 fakes must outbid honest agents for 100 leases every epoch, so cost rises linearly per fake and with demand. Proven fraud burns the stake and freezes the funding vault for 10 epochs.
